source: lab (real recording; background looks replaced by uniform green, watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom-right)

camera.motion: static (no background texture to register against; pendulum pivot stays at a fixed image point within ~3-6 px; phase correlation of the background region gives a constant ~0 shift)
camera.perspective_cues: No ground plane, horizon or furniture visible. The pendulum swings mostly along the camera's line of sight: at the far end of the swing the ball is high in the image (y~301) and small (~27.5 px), the string strongly foreshortened (visible length ~30-45 px); at the near end the ball is lower (y~378-392) and larger (~37.5 px), string visible length ~135-145 px, tilted ~15 deg from image vertical.

objects.name: ball
objects.description: red/orange pendulum bob (sphere), the only coloured object; hangs from a light grey string
objects.reference_point: centroid of the red mask (visible centre)

apparent_diameter_px.note: equiv_diam = 2*sqrt(area/pi); size change is from depth change (ratio ~1.37 => far/near depth ratio ~1.37)

objects.name: string
objects.description: thin light-grey pendulum string from the pivot (top, ~ (637, 229)) to the ball
objects.visible_frames: 1-48 detected (frame 0 motion-blurred, not detected; upper part faint at the far end of the swing)
objects.note: visible length is the 2D projection (foreshortened), not the true length

objects.name: pivot
objects.description: top end of the visible string (suspension point; the support itself is not visible, cut by segmentation)
objects.note: string top x reads 638-641 in frames 1-28 and 633-636 in frames 29-48 (possible small pivot drift or detection noise); y = 227-232 whenever the string is fully visible

events.event: video starts with the ball already swinging, moving up/away toward the far end
far turning point 1 (ball highest in image, smallest)
ball reaches lowest image y on the approach
near turning point 1 (largest ball, max string tilt -15.6 deg, local min of image y)
ball again at lowest image y on the return
far turning point 2 (smallest ball, area 594 px)
near turning point 2 (image y local min 380.2 at f46, string tilt max at f47)
